== Notes ==
* This skill requires exactly 240 units of adrenaline to be fully charged, so 9 strikes and 15 units.
* The conditional only doubles the additional damage this skill adds (it does not double base damage or buffs).

== Trivia ==
* The [[Luxon Guard]] and [[Kurzick Guard]] have a variant of this skill equipped when they are in a [[town]] or [[outpost]]. Their Final Thrust only has a two second [[activation time]], does not require adrenaline to use and deals an additional 32 damage.
